tool_run_completed_has_scores.name: tool_run_completed_has_scores
tool_run_completed_has_scores.value: ("tool_run"."status" = 'completed') = ("tool_run"."scores" IS NOT NULL AND "tool_run"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

credit_hold_settled.name: credit_hold_settled
credit_hold_settled.value:
("credit_hold"."status" = 'active') = ("credit_hold"."settled_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("credit_hold"."status" = 'released') = ("credit_hold"."release_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("credit_hold"."status" = 'charged') = ("credit_hold"."charged_amount" IS NOT NULL)

luna_credit_import_claim_time.name: luna_credit_import_claim_time
luna_credit_import_claim_time.value: "luna_credit_import"."claimed_by_user_id" IS NULL OR "luna_credit_import"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL
